description:
**Rescoped 2026-05-11 after code-state audit.**

Original framing (migrate verify_chain() callers + CHANGELOG) is mostly moot: `verify_chain()` exists at `pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:156–184` and stays. No callers need migration; new wrappers ship alongside.

What remains:

- **CHANGELOG entries** for each new wrapper (`verify_tls_server`, `verify_smime_signer`, `verify_code_signer`, `verify_time_stamper`, `verify_ocsp_responder` — final set per `.7` decision).
- **AGENTS.md `pkix-chain` description update** — current text describes `pkix-chain` as providing `verify_chain()` for the 90% case. Update to include the new per-use wrappers as the 90%-case entry points; `verify_chain()` stays as the lower-level composable form.
- **README updates** in `pkix-chain` reflecting new public API.
- **Semver bump** of `pkix-chain` for the new public API surface (additive — minor version bump).

No deprecation needed for `verify_chain` itself.

**Blocks on:** `.15` (wrappers must exist before being documented).
title: CHANGELOG + AGENTS.md updates for new verify_* wrappers
